_**Agent (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 2026-05-12 09:05:49Z)**_

Your local `main` is behind the remote. Pull the remote changes, then push:

```bash
git pull origin main
git push origin main
```

Or if you prefer a linear history:
```bash
git pull --rebase origin main
git push origin main
```

Don't use `--force-with-lease` unless you intentionally want to discard the remote commits. The pull integrates them safely.
